scope: One long-lived cache and swap directory, eight authored 12 MP RGBA32Float images, actual Metal full-frame readback
checks: All 48 million original component bits per restored image, including signed zero and negative/HDR values
Every full Metal 4000x3000 frame equals its independent retained initial GPU frame
One cache/directory retained across all restores
Full-root pressure refusal followed by successful restore
Cancellation before restore leaves root unchanged
TTL zero applies to newly replaced membership; visible frame retained until unpinned
One RAM entry and 192 MB resident cap
Existing disk entries reused without redundant writes
Root, queue and resident bytes zero after each cycle
limitations: 60 seconds does not prove hours or days of stability
Eight authored float images do not qualify diverse decoding or all 100 formats
No actual viewer prefetch scheduler exercised by this cache test
Local disk and warm filesystem caches do not qualify a physical slow disk
Initial Metal frame comparison proves preservation, not independent color accuracy
Independent frame oracles and driver allocations are outside managed cache accounting
SDR offscreen readback does not qualify physical HDR display
